title: SOC2 prep scratchpad - control mapping notes
content:
Quick notes / running scratchpad for SOC2 control mapping. Mostly reminders to self, gaps, and who to ping. Keep as informal working doc.

Context:
- Working on SOC2 Type 1 readiness for core infra (serving runtime + control plane).
- Focus this week: CM, IA, CC, SI control families (change mgmt, access mgmt, configuration, incident mgmt).
- Goal: draft evidence list for each mapped control and assign owners; identify known gaps and immediate mitigations.

Open questions:
- Do we already have a single source for IAM policies across Hosted/Dedicated/Private? (consolidated policy store?) If not, how to represent in evidence? (screenshot + export?)
- Encryption-at-rest: private deployments use customer KMS; for hosted, confirm CMKs rotation cadence and key lifecycle docs. Who owns rotation? (SRE or infra?)
- Backup retention SLA: need explicit retention policy doc for DB backups (dates, restore test cadence). Who to ask: ops-backups@ or infra owner?

Control mapping (rough):
- CC: Access Controls (CC6/CC7 style)
  - Evidence: IAM console screenshot (groups/roles), access request process doc (confluence), offboarding checklist PRs, sample access review CSV
  - Owner: Maya Singh (eng-sre)
  - Gaps: no automated quarterly access review exported artifact - need script to produce CSV + owner sign-off log

- CM: Change Management / Configuration (CM2 maybe)
  - Evidence: PR review process (github branch protection), change calendar (google calendar), change approval matrix doc
  - Owner: Lena Morales (platform eng)
  - Gaps: emergency change exceptions not always logged in change calendar - propose post-facto ticket requirement (JIRA label: emergency-change)

- IA: Incident Response / Detection
  - Evidence: incident runbook, PagerDuty rotation schedule, postmortem template, sample postmortem
  - Owner: James Kim (oncall lead)
  - Gaps: runbook needs a step to notify security@ + legal for severity 2+ incidents

- SI: System Integrity / Logging
  - Evidence: logging architecture diagram, retention config for logs (elk/s3), sample alert rules (alertmanager), centralized logging access controls
  - Owner: SRE team (tbd)
  - Gaps: retention periods inconsistent across environments - need standard baseline and documented exceptions

Evidence collection checklist (todo):
- [ ] Export IAM groups + members CSV (automate weekly)
- [ ] Grab logs retention configs from logging towers (elk, datadog, s3 lifecycle)
- [ ] Create sample backup restore runbook and schedule a test (owner: infra)
- [ ] Collate change approval emails + calendar entries for last 6 months
- [ ] Pull sample postmortem for sev1 and sev2 incidents (jan 2025 and feb 2026)
- [ ] Confirm KMS key rotation docs + contact for hosted keys

Short-term action items (next 2 sprints):
- Sprint 1 (this week):
  - Automate IAM export script (owner: Maya) - deliver: CSV + quick howto doc
  - Draft policy for emergency changes (owner: Lena) - deliver: confluence page + JIRA label enforcement
  - Add security notification step to incident runbook (owner: James)

- Sprint 2:
  - Backup restore test & runbook (owner: infra)
  - Standardize log retention policy and exceptions doc (owner: SRE lead)
  - Collect sample evidence artifacts and upload to Confluence SOC2 prep space

Notes to self / reminders:
- Reach out to legal for PII handling checklist - might be separate control mapping (privacy implications)
- Consider documenting private deployment evidence separately (customer-managed keys) - note differences in evidence types.
- Keep evidence samples short (screenshots + short explanation), avoid sharing secrets in Confluence (use redaction + refer to SSM/secret manager where needed).

Potential risks and mitigation ideas:
- Risk: scattered evidence across repos + calendars -> mitigation: central Confluence page + GDrive folder with naming convention (SOC2-evidence/YYYY-MM-DD_owner_control).
- Risk: manual access reviews slip -> mitigation: enforce quarterly review reminders in Okta and automate exported CSV to security channel.

Links / refs (quick):
- Confluence SOC2 space: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SOC2/SOC2-prep
- IAM scripts repo (draft): https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-scripts/tree/soc2-iam-exports
- Example postmortem: /confluence/SRE/postmortems/2026-01-sev1

Last thoughts:
- Keep this doc ephemeral - once mapping is stable, move to the SOC2 confluence page and convert checklists to tasks in JIRA (JIRA-SEC project).
- Ping: @Maya, @Lena for quick sync Friday at 11am to align owners and confirm sprint 1 tasks.

Scratchpad history:
- 2025-11-15: initial notes from kickoff call w/ compliance
- 2025-12-02: added CM items after platform review
- 2026-01-10: incident runbook gap noted post-sev2
- 2026-02-20: updated checklist with backup test action

End of scratchpad.
